summary: Comprehensive testing of Foxhounds Wine & Craft Beer Social rebrand completed successfully. Backend APIs 100% functional (17/17 tests passed) including new social check-ins features. Frontend fully rebranded with Foxhounds logo, new membership plans, wine + craft beer integration, and all major sections working correctly.
passed_tests: Backend API health check and all 17 endpoints including new check-ins
Home page loads with Foxhounds logo and 'Where great drinks meet great people' headline
Social feed shows check-in cards with user names, venues, star ratings, drink names, like counts, and wine/beer badges
Tasting kits section shows 6 kits with both wine AND craft_beer category badges
Events section shows 5 events with RSVP buttons and filter tabs (All, In Person, Virtual, Hybrid)
Navigation shows 'Foxhounds' logo with 'Wine & Craft Beer Social' subtitle and all nav links
Admin login working with admin@vineandbarrel.com / VineBarrel2026!, admin link shows in nav
User registration working, redirects to home page
Admin panel loads with overview stats including new check-ins count
Packs page shows 5 packs including 'Virtual Foxhounds' pack with join buttons
Partner page shows inquiry form for wineries/craft breweries
Membership page shows 3 plans: Social Sipper $9.99/mo, Pack Leader $24.99/mo, Foxhound Elite $199.99/yr
Stripe checkout redirects to login when not authenticated (expected behavior)
New social check-ins API endpoints working (POST/GET /api/checkins, POST /api/checkins/{id}/like)
Craft beer category successfully added alongside wine (spirits removed)
New membership plan names implemented: Social Sipper, Pack Leader, Foxhound Elite
Dark warm aesthetic with amber/gold tones maintained

success_percentage.frontend: 100% (all major features and rebrand elements working correctly)
